comment: Issue #3501 Track C: ratcheting baseline for the repo self-migration gate (build/run-cs2gs-selfmig.sh). greenFloor is the minimum number of fully-green apps; the *Ceiling metrics cap readability regressions in the migrated output, counted over CODE lines only (string fixtures and comments excluded). Re-baselined 2026-08-27 after the gate-widening arc (#3585/#3586/#3591/#3593/#3596): 33/52 green, labels 0, lifts 29, lines>300 544, bangs 16912. Denominator 52 -> 51 same day: VsGsharp.UnitTests excluded by policy — the Visual Studio extension stays in C# permanently (like the VSCode extension stays in TypeScript), so its unit tests (linked sources from the extension) are not a migration target. It was red at exclusion time, so greenFloor is unchanged. The bangs ceiling RISES with this re-baseline because six formerly-untranslatable apps (LanguageServer, Repl, Compiler/Extensions/Sdk test projects, ...) now emit whole new code trees — the per-app density did not regress, the measured corpus grew. Improve a metric, then tighten the corresponding number in the same PR. Re-baselined 2026-08-30 after the gate-recovery arc: the first COMPLETE run since the corpus was unblocked (33308959087) reports 38/51 green, so greenFloor rises 33 -> 38. Denominator is 51 (Gsharp.Extensions excluded by #3636 — it is an all-.gs bootstrap project, never a migration target). The other four metrics are NOT tightened: labels stayed 0, lifts stayed 29 (ceiling 30), long lines 554 (ceiling 560), and !! rose slightly 16912 -> 17033 (ceiling 17400) because #3650/#3656/#3657/#3665 legitimately insert null-bridges where the translation previously emitted unsound bare reads — a metric that did not improve must not be ratcheted. Remaining red: Core.Tests (94, a newly-revealed layer behind the gsgen wall #3637 cleared), LanguageServer (5, the GS0155 nil/T? family), InternalAnalyzers.Tests (4, analyzer type-identity), Extensions.Tests (2), Interpreter.Tests (translate), and single errors in Repl, Gsharp.NET.Sdk, Compiler.Tests, LanguageServer.Tests, Sdk.Tests, Cs2Gs.Cli, Cs2Gs.Tests, plus GeneratorHost.Tests failing at TEST-PARITY — the first app to reach that stage and fail there. Long-line ceiling raised 560 -> 575 on 2026-08-30: run 33331139589 measured 563. The +9 over the previous 554 is NOT drift — it is legitimate new nullable spellings emitted by the null-bridging arc (#3650/#3656/#3657/#3665/#3690/#3696/#3701), which replace unsound bare reads with correct `T?` declarations and `!!` bridges; a correct `?`/`!!` costs characters. Verified independent of the concurrent #3704 cascade: unlike the `!!` count (which that cascade inflated, because an app that fails to compile never runs stage 2's polish pass), this app's long-line count was 85 both before AND after its polish pass, so the compile failure does not explain the delta. Headroom chosen so the in-flight nullability work (#3694/#3700/#3706/#3709) does not re-breach on landing; tighten again once that arc settles. The other metrics are unchanged and greenFloor stays 38 pending a clean run. Re-baselined 2026-08-31 after the cascade-clearing arc: run 33358255571 reports 39/51 green with every ceiling satisfied (labels 0, lifts 29, lines>300 572/575, bangs 17135/17400), so greenFloor rises 38 -> 39. Both prior ceiling calls proved correct: the !! count self-resolved 17556 -> 17135 once Cs2Gs.Translator compiled again and reached stage 2's polish pass (confirming that breach was an artifact of a non-compiling app, not a readability regression), and lines>300 came in at 572, which would have breached the old 560 ceiling — the raise to 575 in #3711 was necessary, not indulgent. migrated src/LanguageServer is green for the first time (translate + compile + ilverify + test-parity), as are Cs2Gs.Translator/ProjectLoading/Report/CodeModel and all three gsgen apps. No other metric is tightened: labels and lifts were unchanged, and the two remaining ceilings still carry deliberate headroom for the in-flight nullability work. Re-baselined 2026-08-31 after run 33433830972: 41/51 green with every ceiling satisfied, so greenFloor rises 39 -> 41. Cs2Gs.Pipeline and Cs2Gs.Cli went green once #3728 let the redundant-!! polish reach a real fixed point (their GS0536 walls were the whole blocker; the Microsoft.Build.Locator GS9997 feared alongside them never appeared here — #3738 showed it was an artifact of a hand-run against a symlinked /tmp root, which the gate scripts already canonicalize away). LanguageServer.Tests advanced from 14 compile errors to passing translate+compile+ilverify after #3731/#3733/#3735, and now fails only at test-parity. nullAssertionCeiling tightens 17400 -> 17050: the count fell 17135 -> 16570 (-565) because the null-bridging arc replaced assertions with correctly-typed declarations rather than adding them, so this is a genuine improvement to bank, with ~3% headroom kept to match the file's existing convention. longLineCeiling stays 575 even though the count improved 572 -> 563: that 9-line movement is small relative to the in-flight nullability work (#3741 and the deferred #3705 family-2 decision), and #3711's headroom was sized deliberately for exactly that churn — tighten it once that arc settles. labels (0) and lifts (29) were unchanged and are therefore untouched.
